title: AI-ML-Project
summary: A Jupyter-notebook based machine learning coursework project applying classification and regression models with scikit-learn to a retail dataset. To address class imbalance, the notebook uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer to fit on minority-class rows and generate synthetic samples to augment training data.
